invite.received: <tc:text><tc:accent>{inviter}</tc:accent> invited you to <tc:accent>{name}</tc:accent>. <click:run_command:'/clan accept {tag}'><hover:show_text:'<tc:text>Accept the invite from <tc:accent>{name}</tc:accent>'><tc:accent>[Accept]</tc:accent></hover></click>
accept.none: <tc:error>You have no invite from that clan. Ask a member to invite you.
leave.owner: <tc:error>As owner you must transfer ownership (<tc:accent>/clan setowner</tc:accent>) or disband the clan (<tc:accent>/clan disband</tc:accent>) first.
verify.pending: <tc:info>Note: The tag is pending verification — it becomes visible to other players once a team member approves it.
verify.notified: <tc:success>Your clan <tc:accent>{name}</tc:accent> was verified — the tag <tc:accent>[{tag}]</tc:accent> is now visible.
bank.amount: <tc:error>Amount must be a positive number, e.g. <tc:accent>100</tc:accent>.
bank.withdraw.funds: <tc:error>The clan bank does not have enough crowns.
bank.withdraw.fail: <tc:error>Withdrawal failed. Try again in a moment.
list.empty: <tc:text>No clans exist yet. <click:suggest_command:'/clan create '><hover:show_text:'<tc:text>Put the command into your chat'><tc:accent>/clan create <tag> <name...></tc:accent></hover></click>
error.inclan: <tc:error>You are already in a clan. Leave it first with <tc:accent>/clan leave</tc:accent>.
error.noclan: <tc:error>You are not in a clan. Found one with <tc:accent>/clan create</tc:accent> or accept an invite.
error.unknownclan: <tc:error>No such clan. See all clans with <tc:accent>/clan list</tc:accent>.
error.tagtaken: <tc:error>That tag is already taken. Choose another one.
error.nametaken: <tc:error>That name is already taken. Choose another one.
error.nameformat: <tc:error>The name must be 3-24 characters, without color codes or control characters.
error.notofficer: <tc:error>You must be an officer or the owner.
